reason: I'd totally try the free tricks at a party, but I basically never pay for apps, and 99 shekels for something I'd use a few times feels like a lot. Plus I'm not a magician, I'd probably mess it up in front of everyone.
objection: I'll fumble it and look stupid, and I don't trust paying by card on some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks worked so well that my friends freaked out and I wanted more, and the full version cost around 30 shekels.
